title: Rajani Associates advises lead investor Bajaj Finserv on LUMIQ Series B fundraise
description: Crisp Analytics Private Limited, dba LUMIQ, has raised ₹50 crore from a Series B fundraise led by Bajaj Finserv Ventures Limited, with participation from existing investor Info Edge.Rajani Associates advised lead investor Bajaj Finserv on this fundraise. The Firm's role included reviewing, revising, and negotiating the definitive and other ancillary documents; review of the transaction documents of earlier rounds of investment; assisting clients with the issues flagged in the diligence reports.T
